messages:
rachel: Heads-up: noticed the econ preview shows huge cache savings for tenant-X in the 02:00-03:00 window but ledger shows no corresponding credits. Looks like customers will be surprised. Anyone see why preview vs invoice diverge? :confused:
dee: Can you paste the per-route breakdown you pulled?
rachel: Pasted a quick query:
```
SELECT route, sum(tokens) as toks, sum(prefetch_credit_tokens) as credits
FROM econ_route_agg
WHERE tenant='tenant-X' AND ts >= '2026-03-24T02:00:00Z' AND ts < '2026-03-24T03:00:00Z'
GROUP BY route
```

rachel: Most routes show credits ~= 60% of tokens. Ledger export has credits ~0 for same tenant.
marta: Hmm. Did the ledger job pick up the prefetch_credit tag? Which field does the billing job join on?
dee: Billing joins on billing_token_tag which is written by the sidecar at request completion. Econ preview aggregates from cached credit table populated asynchronously. If sidecar failed to attach tag due to pressure, ledger wouldn't see credits.
infra-bot: [ALERT] sidecar-writer service: elevated error rate (5xx) between 2026-03-24T01:55:00Z and 2026-03-24T02:12:00Z. trace=svc-sidecar-err-20260324-01
rachel: That window matches. Any reason sidecar failed?
dee: Ops: the sidecar writer had a transient TLS handshake failure to the metadata-store (PKI rotation in staging leaked certs into prod config). We rotated certs but some pods didn't restart.
marta: So econ preview (reads from prefetch-credit service) shows credits, but final ticket to ledger missing tag -> divergence. Two mitigation paths: backfill ledger tags for affected invocations or mark the econ preview as "unreconciled" for that window. Which do we prefer?
dee: For customer invoices we must reconcile ledger. Backfill is doable but we need deterministic keys to join. Do we have invocation ids persisted for those cache-credit rows?
rachel: Yes each credit row has invocation_id and cache_key. I'll run a backfill join job to emit billing_token_tag for missing invocations. Job id=backfill-sidecar-615.
infra-bot: [INFO] backfill-sidecar-615 scheduled at 2026-03-24T08:30:00Z
marta: UX: let's add an "unreconciled credits" badge to the per-tenant econ card when preview credits differ from ledger credits by >5% for a window. Hover should explain: "Previewed credits come from credit-service; invoices use ledger tags attached at completion. If sidecars failed, preview may overstate savings."
dee: Also add an API param to econ preview: include_ledger_match=true which returns ledger_tokens and preview_tokens so UI can surface deltas.
rachel: I'll update the dashboard mock. Small request from PMs: include a one-click 'request invoice review' button for >20% delta that files a billing ticket and emails the customer.
billing: please link a template for credit adjustments. We need tenant id, window, sample of invocation_ids, and reason code (SIDEcar_MISSING_TAG).
dee: I'll add reason code SIDEcar_MISSING_TAG and a short postmortem stub in infra runbook. Long-term fix: make sidecar writer idempotent and move billing tag emission to the runtime right after token accounting (not dependent on separate sidecar).
marta: Timeline: (1) UI badge + hover + request-review button (2 sprint), (2) backfill job for this incident + credits adjustments (today), (3) move tag emission to runtime sidecar/rewrite (2 sprints). Owners: rachel=backfill + filing billing ticket, dee=infra fix + ledger gate, marta=UI flag + button, billing=adjustment PR.
infra-bot: [INFO] backfill-sidecar-615 started at 2026-03-24T08:31:02Z job=backfill-sidecar-615
rachel: Backfill completed. Found 8.2k invocations with missing tags; ledger updated. Econ preview now matches ledger within 0.7%. I placed a temporary banner on econ dash explaining the earlier mismatch and that invoices were corrected.
dee: Thanks. We'll follow up with a postmortem and the PKI rotation checklist. Also adding the ledger_match param to the econ API RFC.
marta: Will ship the UI badge as a small A/B to enterprise customers first. UX copy: "Preview vs invoice mismatch: recent system error may cause differences. Click for details or to request manual review."
billing: Received billing ticket and queued manual adjustments. Notifying support to contact affected customers.
rachel: Closing loop: created postmortem PR and linked this thread. Thanks team.
